newsitem.title: ABU DHABI: SOCCER-HOSTS UAE AND S.KOREA DRAW 1-1 IN ASIAN CUP OPENER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HOSTS UAE AND S.KOREA DRAW 1-1 IN ASIAN CUP OPENER.

text.p: Hosts the United Arab Emirates came from behind to draw 1-1 with South Korea on Wednesday in the opening match of the Asian Cup soccer tournament.
Goalscorer Hwang Sun-hong could have clinched it for South Korea in injury time when, with only the goalkeeper to beat, he shot just wide of the right post.

Hwang, running on to a delightful through ball from midfield, opened the scoring for South Korea in the ninth minute. He fired a left-foot shot from just inside the penalty area into the bottom corner of the goal.
Hwang, whose speed and sharpness troubled the UAE defence throughout the match, could have had two more goals but for good saves from goalkeeper Muhsin Fairouz, the first from a clear header.
But as South Korea's domination began to to become embarrassing, the UAE hit back through striker Khamis Saad.
Adel Ahmed turned well to beat Korea's Roh Sang-rae on the left flank before sending a harmless-looking cross into the area.
The Korean central defenders failed to clear, presenting Saad with a chance to control the ball on the edge of the six-yard box before slotting the ball into the right corner of Kim Byung-ji's goal.

UAE: 17-Muhsin Fairoz, 4-Abdel Rahman Al-Haddad; 5-Yousef Saleh (2-Adel Hussain 46); 6-Ismail Ismail; 7-Bakhit Saad; 10- Adnan Khamis (16-Hassan Ahmed 82); 12- Hassan Mubarak; 14- Khamis Saad (11-Zhair Bkhait 49); 15-Mohamed Mohamed; 19-Ali Ghawas; 23-Adel Ahmed.

South Korea: 1-Kim Byung-ji; 5-Huh Ki-tae; 6-Shin Hong-gi (7-Sin Tae-yong 82); 8-Roh Sang-rae (12-Lee Ki-hyung 64th); 9- Kim Do-hoon (19-Seo Jung-won 73); 11-Ko Jeong-woon; 17-Ha Seok-ju; 18-Hwang Sun-hong; 20-Hong Myung-bo; 22-Lee Young-jin; 24- Kim Joo-sung.
